summary: Reproduced the decoded-text dictionary collision: three candidates became two and the lower-ranked duplicate overwrote the higher-ranked score. Chat Completions and Responses now consume an excluded, ordered raw-candidate field that preserves every candidate, while the legacy Completions dictionary remains wire-compatible and retains the first (best-ranked) duplicate.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on the recorded base: candidate_count=2 and replacement_logprob=-2.5 instead of three candidates with the higher-ranked -0.5 entry retained. Raw output: reports/j-7c3ec2d6e068/reproduce_before.log
Passing-after Chat response conversion: candidate_count=3 in source order with both replacement-character candidates and scores -0.5 and -2.5. Raw output: reports/j-7c3ec2d6e068/reproduce_after.log

193 tests passed and 72 subtests passed, covering duplicate preservation in Chat and Responses, ordered unique candidates, missing top-logprob positions, legacy LogProbs fallback, and adjacent endpoint behavior. Raw output: reports/j-7c3ec2d6e068/pytest.log
Patch whitespace validity and Python syntax for every changed source and regression file.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced defect and corrected code are CPU-only OpenAI response shaping. No model engine or GPU kernel was executed, so no gfx950 or model-level claim is made.

remaining_limitations: The original DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 TP4 workload on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs was not reproduced; those weights and that multi-GPU CUDA hardware are unavailable, and the assigned single gfx950 cannot qualify it.

Original tokenizer bytes are still not carried through the internal tuple, so byte-fallback candidates continue to expose the UTF-8 encoding of decoded U+FFFD. This adjacent representation issue is explicitly outside the collision fix.

The legacy Completions API represents top_logprobs as a decoded-text-keyed JSON object and therefore cannot expose duplicate decoded strings; it now deterministically retains the first/best-ranked candidate.
The prepared interpreter does not include ruff or black; formatting modules could not be run. git diff --check, py_compile, and focused unit suites passed.
